versions.changelog:
A/B testing landing pages: Essential guidelines for effective experiments.

- Introduces a comprehensive skill guide for planning, running, and analyzing A/B tests on landing pages.
- Emphasizes testing one element at a time and prioritizing high-impact page elements.
- Details requirements for statistical significance and proper segmentation of results.
- Stresses the importance of thorough test documentation and avoiding common A/B testing mistakes.
- Includes a quick reference table for expected performance lift from key elements.
- Recommends validating results with AI-simulated user testing via Racoonn, with an API waitlist announced.
